description: This file contains the implementation of the Stream class that adheres to the PSR HTTP message interface, providing methods for stream handling such as reading, writing, metadata access, and stream management.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Implementation of PSR HTTP streams providing methods to manage and interact with stream resources, supporting reading, writing, seeking, and metadata operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Stream object with a given string or resource stream and optional mode.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the stream contents as a string, rewinding if necessary, or empty string on error.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes and detaches the internal stream resource.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying PHP stream resource from the object.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a new stream/resource to the object, replacing the existing one.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available, or null.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the file read/write pointer or throws an exception if unavailable.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached end-of-file.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata or specific metadata key from the stream.

methods.name: setStream
methods.description: Sets the internal stream resource, either from a string or resource, ensuring it's valid.

methods.name: isValidStreamResourceType
methods.description: Checks if a given resource is of an allowed type to handle streams.
